status: Actual installed imports/explicit patch installers and native config gates passed; read-only admin registration passed. Model/weight-adoption GPU acceptance remains separately pending.

LoRA loader rebase.finding: Target method lacks TensorizerConfig branch; production copy retains actual target loading behavior, changing only expert suffix/qualified-name acceptance.

Prompt-budget patch removal.finding: TokenizeParams.max_input_tokens returns max_total_tokens; generation budget no longer reserved from prompt budget. Genuine target tests required.

Qwen newline patch removal.finding: Native _trim_wrapping_newlines removes exactly one leading and trailing newline and converter uses it for complete/partial parameters.

Harmony stop patch removal.finding: Native to_sampling_params merges request and default stop_token_ids, preserving order and removing duplicates.

NIXL routed bypass removal.finding: Aux-output flag moved out of model_config; native compatibility checker rejects P/D and requires V2. Root-approved P/D/routing deferral, not an upstream correctness-fix claim.

V1 padded-input scrub retained.finding: Exact _preprocess(self,scheduler_output,num_input_tokens,intermediate_tensors=None) boundary retained; return leading input_ids/inputs_embeds/positions unchanged. Native zeroes positions tail but does not equivalently scrub all input arrays.

KV finish patch rebase.finding: Preserves native _set_kv_fetch_stage(req,KV_FETCH_COMPLETED_WAITING) in addition to prior freed-request tolerance.

FP32 lm_head compatibility.finding: New skip_gather argument forwarded when disabled and honored before gather when enabled; original native bf16xbf16->fp32 GEMM remains unchanged.

DP timeout retained.finding: Same _wait_for_zmq_addrs method and120-second native wait; existing bounded300-second custom override retained.

Native route serialization.finding: GenerateResponseBase instances serialize model_dump directly, so response subclass literal-token representation is preserved without base-schema recoercion.

Native dev admin collision.finding: Native RL mutation router registers only in dev mode and precedes appended custom routes, including an incompatible POST /update_weights. Experimental profile rejects dev mode explicitly; no route surgery. Read-only status is available in the custom router.

Official label and pause observation.finding: GET /weight_info uses await engine.get_weight_version and GET /is_paused uses await engine.is_paused. Custom read-only endpoints use the same official client APIs without enabling dev mutations.

RoPE override semantics.finding: Native dictionary override replaces dict-valued rope_parameters after config loading. That can drop checkpoint theta. Supported callable override runs before native normalization and preserves flat checkpoint theta/partial values, with explicit nested rejection. Actual config-loader probe provides separate execution evidence.

Absent filesystem weights.finding: _get_weights_iterator is ordinary synchronous function returning a generator expression after _prepare_weights. Empty directory raises Cannot find any model weights before our worker enters layerwise reload. Actual failure/paused/version/recovery behavior remains runtime-gated.

scope: No imported P/D workaround suite, packed-logprob optimization, new models or GC tuning.
